newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq sets another record ahead of Thanksgiving.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq sets another record ahead of Thanksgiving.

text.p: Large cap high techs propelled the Nasdaq Composite to another record close, its sixth this month and the fourth in a row.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 6.12 points, or 0.48 percent, at 12787.32, while advances inched ahead of declining issues by 2168 to 1984.
The previous record was set on Tuesday, when the Compsoite inched up 0.83 points to close at 1281.20.
"I think that on a relative basis, the (Nasdaq) Composite is less exploited than the other averages," said Greg Nie, technical analyst at EVEREN Securities.
"I don't believe it's extended. Its breakout point was at the 1250 level. It retested that level a couple of weeks ago and now has its footing again and is it is still relatively early in the move."

Led by industry giant Intel Corp, shares of a handful of high techs rose in mid-afternoon as hedge fund managers sought to add the issues to their portfolios before the close of their fiscal years on Friday.
Intel, the most actively traded Nasdaq issue, was up 2-7/8 at 126-5/8. The stock market will be closed on Thursday for the Thanksgiving Day holiday. It reopens on Friday.
